questions.question: A dataset has 100 records, with 60 in Class A and 40 in Class B. What is P(A)?
questions.question_ar: تضم مجموعة البيانات 100 سجل، منها 60 في الفئة A و40 في B. فما قيمة P(A)؟

questions.question: Using the same 100-record dataset, what is P(B)?
questions.question_ar: باستخدام مجموعة البيانات نفسها ذات 100 سجل، فما قيمة P(B)؟

questions.question: In Class A, 30 of 60 records have Weather = Sunny. What is P(Sunny | A)?
questions.question_ar: في الفئة A، لدى 30 سجلاً من أصل 60 طقس Sunny. فما قيمة P(Sunny | A)؟

questions.question: Given P(A) = 0.6, P(Sunny | A) = 0.5, and P(Mild | A) = 0.8, what is Score(A)?
questions.question_ar: إذا كانت P(A)=0.6 وP(Sunny|A)=0.5 وP(Mild|A)=0.8، فما Score(A)؟

questions.question: What unnormalized score is calculated for Play = Yes?
questions.question_ar: ما الدرجة غير المطَبّعة المحسوبة لفئة Play = Yes؟
questions.explanation: The Yes score (0.375) is greater than the No score (0.03125), so the prediction is Play = Yes.

questions.question: What unnormalized score is calculated for Play = No?
questions.question_ar: ما الدرجة غير المطَبّعة المحسوبة لفئة Play = No؟
questions.explanation: The Yes score (0.375) is greater than the No score (0.03125), so the prediction is Play = Yes.

questions.question: What is the normalized probability for Play = Yes?
questions.question_ar: ما الاحتمال المطَبّع لفئة Play = Yes؟
questions.explanation: After normalization, the probabilities are approximately 92.3% for Yes and 7.7% for No. The unnormalized scores are sufficient for comparing classes.

questions.question: What can happen if an attribute value never occurs in a class?
questions.question_ar: ماذا قد يحدث إذا لم تظهر قيمة سمة مطلقاً ضمن فئة؟
questions.explanation: If an attribute value never occurs in a class, its estimated likelihood is zero. Multiplying by zero can make the entire score for that class zero.
